services.subtitle: Three disciplines. One studio. We build digital products that scale, perform, and feel exceptional.
services.strategy_desc: We map your product's foundation before a line of code is written - discovery, roadmapping, tech stack selection, and system design that holds under scale.
services.engineering_desc: Production-ready builds across the full stack - React, Next.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. From API architecture to deployment on AWS and Vercel.
services.performance_desc: Interfaces built to move. GSAP-powered animations, Lenis smooth scroll, and a minimalist visual language designed to stop the scroll.

projects.title: Case Stud<highlight>i</highlight>es
projects.subtitle: Selected case studies - each one a system built to solve a real problem, shipped on schedule, and designed to last.
projects.yup_desc: Yup.io was a growing SaaS platform held back by a legacy frontend that couldn't match the product's scale. We redesigned the core architecture - refactoring legacy components into a modern React and TailwindCSS system that performs fast, ships clean, and supports the product's next stage of growth.
projects.yup_alt: Yup.io SaaS platform - legacy frontend refactored into a React and TailwindCSS production architecture
projects.bullshit_desc: NFC-tagged artworks existed in physical isolation - no digital discovery layer, no global reach. We built a full-stack geospatial platform with Next.js 15 and MapboxGL on the frontend, backed by Node/Express/TypeScript and MongoDB geospatial queries - turning every scanned piece into a live pin on a world map.
projects.bullshit_alt: Full-stack geospatial web application built with Next.js, MapboxGL, and Node.js
projects.michal_desc: An artist needed a digital presence that put the work front and centre - no clutter, no friction. We built a minimal gallery site with smooth scroll animations, fully responsive layouts, and a clean visual language that gets out of the way and lets the art speak.
projects.michal_alt: Artist gallery website built with Next.js and TailwindCSS
projects.better_desc: Ofir needed a fully Hebrew RTL digital presence for her personal coaching and events practice - one she could manage independently without a developer. We built a WCAG 2.1 AA accessible one-page site with Decap CMS integration, giving Ofir full control over content, images, and events without touching a line of code.
projects.better_alt: Hebrew RTL landing page for personal coach Ofir - built with React, Vite, TailwindCSS, and Decap CMS with full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility

about.bio2: The studio was founded by Kim Kroll - a Full-Stack developer with a track record of leading product engineering on live SaaS platforms, delivering performance, reliability, and stability under real user load.
about.bio3: Our process is built on clarity, craftsmanship, and delivery. We don't just write code - we engineer products that scale with your ambition.

pillars.yup_challenge: Yup.io was a growing SaaS platform held back by a legacy frontend that couldn't match the product's velocity. Component bloat, inconsistent patterns, and a fragile style layer were slowing every release.
pillars.yup_result: We redesigned the core architecture - refactoring legacy components into a modern React and TailwindCSS system that performs fast, ships clean, and supports the product's next stage of growth.
pillars.bullshit_challenge: NFC-tagged artworks existed in physical isolation - no digital discovery layer, no global reach. Each piece was invisible the moment it left the gallery wall.
pillars.bullshit_result: We built a full-stack geospatial platform with Next.js 15, MapboxGL, and MongoDB geospatial queries - turning every scanned piece into a live pin on a world map.
pillars.michal_challenge: An artist needed a digital presence that put the work front and centre. Existing templates imposed structure that competed with the art instead of framing it.
pillars.michal_result: We built a minimal gallery site with smooth scroll animations, fully responsive layouts, and a clean visual language that gets out of the way and lets the art speak.
pillars.better_challenge: The goal was to eliminate technical friction. Ofir needed a digital presence that reflected her professional precision while granting her total independence to manage content and events without relying on a developer.
pillars.better_result: We engineered a seamless balance between high-end UI and a custom-fitted CMS. The result is a fully accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) platform that empowers her to lead her practice with confidence, supported by invisible yet robust technology.
